_comment: Slot-fillable phrases per dim token in en + es. Phrases are 2-8 words, designed to compose into Obra-Dinn-style detective prose. The composer assembles them per the grammar in SCHEMA.md. The detective is referred to as 'the detective' (en) / 'la detective' (es) — gender female by default; configurable.
